environment.checkpoint_description: Qwen3.5-4B; converted BF16 weights to MXFP8; single activation limb

method.metric: median GPU microseconds; randomized paired CUDA Graph replay
method.chain_cache: distinct layers; total weight footprint recorded

limitations: One GPU model and one MXFP8 checkpoint; each service arm has only two fresh lifecycles.
Custom fixed-token HTTP workload; this is not the public six-point protocol.
Complete-model HTTP workload includes attention, GDN, scheduling, prefill and LM head.
Hot projection, eight-layer synthetic activation chain and full service are distinct measurement boundaries.
Graph chains use real weights with synthetic activations; they are not full model forwards.
Response text hashes are recorded; output equivalence under variable batching is evaluated separately from fixed-shape bitwise kernel checks.
Fusion environment flags were requested; server logs do not establish applied norm/MLP fusion counts.
GPU clocks were not locked; forward/reverse ordering reduces drift but cannot establish significance for sub-percent changes.
